And Sunday? The earlier return made me nervous.

Still workable. Checkout is 11:00, and leaving the suite at 10:15 gives roughly two hours at DEN before the 1:05 p.m. Delta departure. messages.content: Raleigh just came through. Pediatric Steps wants me mid-November for a Monday-Tuesday clinic training near RDU, with Sunday arrival. They may add a short Wednesday observation. Can you build flight and hotel options, grouped by practical fit rather than just cheapest?
Absolutely. What dates should I treat as live, and do they need you teaching early Monday?
Sunday Nov 15 arrival. Monday and Tuesday start at 8. Tuesday should end around 3, but the lead says it could slip. Wednesday is maybe an 8:30-10:30 observation if she gets staff coverage.

Got it. I’ll compare two trip shapes: Sunday-to-Tuesday if Tuesday ends cleanly, and Sunday-to-Wednesday if the observation is confirmed. Do you want me to include late cheap connections, or only options that leave you usable Monday morning?
Include the late cheap one only as a backup. The teaching days are too early to arrive wiped out.

Flight shortlist by practicality: 1) Best working fit is a Sunday nonstop TPA-RDU around 2:20-4:05 p.m., currently about $230-$260 one-way depending fare bundle. It gets you in before dinner and avoids connection risk. 2) Cheapest backup is a Sunday evening connection through ATL or CLT, leaving around 6 and arriving close to 10:30 p.m., about $90-$120 less but a rough setup before an 8 a.m. start. 3) Morning nonstop works operationally, but I do not see a reason to burn the whole Sunday unless the fare drops.
Keep the Sunday nonstop out front. What about returning?

If you leave Tuesday, the best fit is a 6:10 p.m.-ish return, but it only works if Tuesday ends by about 3:30 and traffic cooperates. The 4:45 connection is too tight if the debrief slips. If you stay Wednesday, the clean option is a 1:30-2:30 p.m. departure after the observation, getting you back to Tampa early evening without an airport sprint.

I don't want to gamble on a Tuesday airport sprint. Put the Wednesday return in the recommended path unless the clinic rules it out. For hotels, look at reliability and whether the room setup is clear, not just nearest.

Hotels: two realistic choices. The clinic-rate hotel by the therapy park is 3-5 minutes from the clinic at about $129-$139/night, but recent reviews sit around 3.7/5 with noise and maintenance notes, and the desk still cannot verify an in-room refrigerator. It lists a coffee maker in some room types, a small fitness room, seasonal outdoor pool, and no clear hot tub.
That sounds like the kind of place that becomes annoying at 6:30 a.m. What's the other one?

Harbor Suites Raleigh-Cary is about 15 minutes away. It is rated 4.3/5 recently, has a queen studio available, and confirms an in-room coffee maker and mini-fridge. Indoor pool and fitness room are confirmed. Plain caveat: no hot tub. Rate is about $169-$182/night, parking included.
No hot tub isn't ideal, but fridge and a reliable room matter more for this one. Is the commute ugly?

Not bad. Normal morning drive is 14-18 minutes; worst case looks closer to 25 if I-40 gets messy. Rideshares estimate $18-$26 each way, but pickup around the clinic can be less predictable during afternoon dismissal.
So hotel plus transportation: which is most practical?

Most practical if Wednesday stays possible: Harbor Suites plus a compact rental car. It costs more than the clinic-rate hotel plus rideshares, but it removes the fridge uncertainty, gives you control for the early starts, and handles the Wednesday clinic-to-airport move. Value but riskier: clinic-rate hotel plus rideshares. Cheapest-only: late Sunday connection plus clinic hotel, but I would keep that as emergency fare protection, not the plan.
Good. What do we need from the clinic before booking?

Ask them for five things: whether Wednesday 8:30-10:30 is confirmed, Tuesday hard stop or realistic latest end time, where you can store demo materials Monday and Tuesday overnight, whether you need to bring treatment mats or if theirs are available, and parking/check-in instructions if you use a rental car.
Add whether they can receive a small shipped box. I may not want to fly with all demo items.

Added: shipping address, attention line, receiving hours, and how long they will hold the box. I also added whether the observation requires you to bring the box back Wednesday or if materials can be left with the staff lead.
For now hold the suite if it has free cancellation. Don't book flights until Wednesday is settled.

I placed a refundable hold at Harbor Suites Raleigh-Cary for Sun Nov 15-Wed Nov 18: queen studio, $176/night before taxes, free cancellation until Friday Nov 13. Caveat remains no hot tub, but queen bed, coffee maker, mini-fridge, indoor pool, fitness room, and parking are confirmed. I’ll keep the Sunday nonstop and Wednesday afternoon return as the working flight plan and send the clinic confirmation list.
